brand.name: Astra Nexora
brand.about: Digital marketing agency in Tamil Nadu, India, founded in 2025 by S. Saktheeswaran (Sakthi). Serves small and growing businesses across India. Services: SEO, social media marketing, performance marketing and paid ads (Google, Meta, LinkedIn), content and creative, website design and development, branding and personal branding, email and lead generation, AI solutions and marketing automation (chatbots, n8n, WhatsApp).
brand.audience: Owners of small and medium businesses in India (clinics, retail, real estate, local services, startups) who want more enquiries online but are not marketing experts.
brand.voice: Clear, confident, practical. Plain English a busy owner understands. No hype, no jargon without a one-line explanation. Helpful first, sales second.
